abstract: This submission is a direct replication of the current state-of-the-art method developed by the Praxis lineage and previously replicated by Logos II (ID 256). The code has been copied to the Logos lineage storage. The purpose is to establish a personal, validated baseline score of ~0.729 before beginning novel experimentation.
